devdoc.details: The StakeVaultV2 lock under the intent hash holds owner, amount and maturity; this policy stores only the depositor and payment method a dispute needs, and whether the lock is a deferred payout. Canonical USDC only.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params._disputeNullifierRegistry: Dedicated registry that rejects reused dispute nullifiers.
params._orchestratorRegistry: Registry of orchestrators allowed to call the settlement callbacks.
params._owner: Governance owner for policy and dependency configuration.
params._stakeVault: Vault holding and locking taker collateral.

onDeferredPayoutFunded((bytes32,address,.details: O4 passes the same context it passed to settleIntent, in the same transaction.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

settleIntent((bytes32,address,address,ad.details: settlementData is abi.encode(uint256 disputeWindow). Zero windows and non-stake tokens pay now.

returns.deferralVault: Zero to pay intent.to now; otherwise the vault that receives netAmount.

params._attestation: Signed dispute evidence for a settled intent.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

protections.details: Open protections keyed by globally unique intent hash; deleted on release or dispute.

devdoc.title: DisputeProtectionPolicyV2

constructor.notice: Creates the policy; authorize it as a vault controller and a dispute-nullifier writer before use.

disputeNullifierRegistry().notice: Dedicated replay registry for payment-method-scoped dispute nullifiers.

disputeVerifier().notice: Verifier used to validate signed dispute evidence.

getProtection(bytes32).notice: Returns the open protection for an intent; zero after release or dispute.

onDeferredPayoutFunded((bytes32,address,.notice: Locks the net payout O4 just transferred to the deferral vault.

orchestratorRegistry().notice: Orchestrators allowed to call the settlement callbacks.

release(bytes32[]).notice: Releases every listed protection whose lock has matured. A taker's stake returns to its owner's free stake; a deferred payout is transferred to its recipient, so recipients that cannot call the vault still get paid.

renounceOwnership().notice: Disables ownership renunciation so governed safety controls cannot become unreachable.

setDisputeVerifier(address).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Replaces the verifier used for future dispute submissions.

settleIntent((bytes32,address,address,ad.notice: Selects immediate or deferred settlement for a verified fulfilment by a non-whitelisted taker.

stakeVault().notice: Stake custody and lock accounting controlled by this policy.

submitDispute((bytes32,bytes32,bytes[],b.notice: Resolves valid dispute evidence into an immediately claimable depositor award.

userdoc.notice: Settles OrchestratorV4 payouts against the taker's stake, or defers them, for the signed dispute window.
